title: Check If a Word Occurs As a Prefix of Any Word in a Sentence
summary: Given a sentence with words separated by a single space and a searchWord, check if searchWord is a prefix of any word in the sentence.
statement: Given a sentence with words separated by a single space and a searchWord, check if searchWord is a prefix of any word in the sentence. Return the index of the first word (1-indexed) where searchWord is a prefix. If searchWord is a prefix of multiple words, return the index of the first occurrence. If searchWord is not a prefix of any word, return -1. A prefix of a string is any contiguous substring that starts at the beginning of the string.
constraints: Return the one-based index of the first sentence word beginning with search_word.
Return -1 when no word has that prefix.
hints: Split the sentence into words in order.
Return immediately for the first word whose startswith test succeeds.
If the scan ends, no qualifying word exists and -1 is required.
editorial: If the scan ends, no qualifying word exists and -1 is required.
